pr.title: Add automatic card pictures and a live board workspace
pr.body: ## Summary Parents building a board on master can use emoji and personal photos, but a generic truck emoji cannot distinguish a dump truck from other vehicles. AI drafts also share a modal with the conversation, leaving less room to review the board while refining it. This change adds automatic picture selection and a full-page draft workspace. Automatic keeps accurate emoji, fills gaps with licensed library artwork, and generates an illustration only when a gap still needs one. Pictures appear as they finish; parents can stop work, adjust source choices, and explicitly save the reviewed draft. Failed picture work keeps a usable emoji or existing saved picture. Photos and protected pictures survive board-wide changes, and downloaded PNGs remain available offline. New board opens the conversation directly; Build manually is a separate entry. Inline notices explain picture processing and server-cache retention before starter generation or AI picture work. Source choices are available for the draft, board, card, and new-board defaults. This diff also includes the web introduction at `/`, with the application at `/app` and unchanged entry behavior for existing installed web apps. **Target:** `master` at `5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04`; no parent PR. Review PR6 before dependent #13. Current head: `2be85f0cb02cd5ba464f46c623b9b19cf5061231`. [Picture behavior and configuration](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/2be85f0cb02cd5ba464f46c623b9b19cf5061231/docs/PICTURES.md). ## Test plan and behavior evidence | Scenario | Intended outcome and actual observation | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | | Existing library; request “Cow, sheep, and a dump truck” | Keep the two accurate animal emoji and improve only the truck. The production web app requested one picture job and displayed the real library symbol in its separate canvas; master displayed three emoji in a modal. | Matched desktop pair below; retained fixture and served-bundle hashes. Controlled service selection demonstrates presentation and targeting, not live AI accuracy. | | No suitable library picture and generation unavailable | Keep the draft usable. The phone app retained the truck emoji, showed one fallback explanation, and enabled Use this board. Browser regression also saved the fallback board, reloaded offline, and found every card. | Matched phone pair below; fallback browser scenario in the [test log](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure/browser.log). | | Stop partial picture work; change source; protect a card; retry a failed save | Stop releases provider selection and shared-catalog wait capacity without interrupting other subscribers, cancels outstanding jobs without saving a partial draft, restores the prompt, and excludes discarded turns from retry context; source changes wait for an explicit update; protected pictures remain; browser Back/Forward cannot discard a pending save, and retry saves exactly once. The 32 affected Chromium scenarios passed, including offline PNG persistence, reduced motion, keyboard selectors, reload/Back and microphone cleanup. | [Maintained scenarios](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/tree/b2b268e670c889dcda912eac822295278e3cf093/tests/web) and the same executed test log; [server cancellation/capacity regression](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/ecb5cea3642a32c8d9edc472f54988f41668f7cb/docs/review/pr6-selection/README.md). | | Inherit Library only/Emoji only on a migrated board; override a board/card; retry slow picture analysis or review | Non-generating modes disable generation and execution sends no generation permission; explicit overrides remain available. Real-SDK/API regressions observed a safe error before the client deadline and a successful retry after server capacity was released, without hidden provider retries. | [Maintained checks and affected policy captures](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a1d42e70ff5dadea9c58d316848cda5c7e607f64/docs/review/pr6-policy/README.md). Timeout tests use controlled fetch and elapsed time, not paid provider calls. | | Save a tile edit; close or stop optional pictures; refine duplicate-label drafts | The saved words survive picture dismissal and reload. Applying pictures uses the saved revision. Different meanings with the same label retain their own pictures after reordering, and each prior picture is reused at most once. | [Three browser save scenarios and two semantic regressions](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/README.md). | | Read first-run and parent privacy notices | Parents can see what goes to OpenAI, what stays on the device, and which picture data remains in the server cache without automatic deletion. | Master-to-final privacy and setup pairs below; actual provider/cache behavior inspected. | | Fresh visit to `/`; open the web app | Explain the app before setup. The new homepage links to `/app`; master immediately opens language setup. Browser tests confirmed no homepage library/API initialization and preserved legacy standalone launches. | Matched homepage pair below and landing-page scenarios. | ### Before / After: picture draft **Before:** actual master `5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04`. **After captured source:** `02cb85c5e4aaaae056ace73ef6fda591bd0bc500`, captured before the current head `2be85f0cb02cd5ba464f46c623b9b19cf5061231`. Both sides are genuine isolated production builds. Later manual policy/save/privacy and live provider timeout/cancellation changes do not execute in these settled mocked scenes. Picture reuse also does not run in this first-turn, unique-label draft; the captures remain applicable. [Exact impact assessment](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/1fd973b318313dc1f1e524f7a1e71f245380d29b/docs/review/pr6-catalog-cancel/README.md). Both isolated production builds used identical synthetic boards, prompts, viewport, light theme, DPR 1, en-US/UTC, fixed Date, and reduced motion. Service workers were blocked; no DOM/CSS hiding or pixel edits. AI/job replies were controlled. The truck is real pinned Mulberry artwork rasterized by the production library path, not a generated mockup. Mulberry Symbols by Steve Lee, CC BY-SA 4.0. [Exact capture manifest, image hashes and running-build verification](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/manifest.json) · [Reproduction, fixture/harness identities and coverage limits](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/README.md). Provenance commit: `7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65`. | Before — modal with generic truck, 1280×900 | After — gap-only library picture and separate canvas, 1280×900 | | --- | --- | | ![Before: master emoji draft](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/before-ready-1280.png?raw=true) | ![After: animal emoji retained and dump-truck picture ready](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/after-ready-1280.png?raw=true) | ### Before / After: unavailable picture Same request and 390×844 phone viewport. Master has no automatic picture service; After explains the unavailable improvement without blocking the usable draft. | Before — emoji draft | After — saveable fallback with one explanation | | --- | --- | | | | ### Before / After: web entry Fresh storage and the same `/` route at 1280×900. The new introduction provides an explicit path into the application. | Before — setup immediately | After — introduction and Open web app | | --- | --- | | ![Before: master language setup at root](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/before-home-1280.png?raw=true) | ![After: website introduction at root](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/after-home-1280.png?raw=true) | ### Before / After: picture-data disclosure **Before:** master `5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04`. **After captured source:** `b2b268e670c889dcda912eac822295278e3cf093`; the final backend-only catalog-wait repair does not affect these pixels. Same synthetic library, Parent settings privacy section,1280x1000, light/DPR1/en-US/UTC and fixed Date. Real scrolling reveals the complete section; no hiding or edited pixels. The final text adds descriptions and picture pixels sent for matching/review, offline picture storage, and server cache retention. [Exact source/build/fixture provenance and image hashes](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure/privacy-manifest.json), bound to evidence commit `c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb`; [reproduction and scope](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure/README.md). | Before — earlier prompt/audio disclosure | After — picture flow and retention disclosed | | --- | --- | | ![Before: master parent privacy](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure/base-privacy.png?raw=true) | ![After: picture-data privacy disclosure](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure/after-privacy.png?raw=true) | ### Before / After: first-run disclosure Same fresh English-default setup, before pressing Generate starter boards,390x844 phone viewport. **Before:** master `5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04`. **After:** `b2b268e670c889dcda912eac822295278e3cf093`. The added inline notice explains picture data, recipient, potential generation cost and cache retention before the action; generation remains one step. [Source/build/fixture manifest](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure/manifest.json) and [desktop plus other picture-entry captures](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure/README.md), bound to `c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb`. Both sides use normal scrolling to reveal the complete disclosure and action; no UI hiding or pixel edits. | Before — earlier setup disclosure | After — picture use explained before generation | | --- | --- | | | | ## Supporting checks and limitations On MCHARTIER_ZBOOK, current source passed release metadata, TypeScript, **205 unit/server tests**, server/web builds, and **32 Chromium picture/conversation/setup scenarios** on `b2b268e670c889dcda912eac822295278e3cf093`; the final backend-only repair leaves the entire mobile source tree unchanged. These include stopped work, semantic picture reuse, independent tile saves, optional picture apply, failed draft save/retry, repeated Back/Forward, offline PNGs, reduced motion, keyboard controls, microphone cleanup, setup recovery, and visible initial phone disclosure. [Exact checks, behavioral observations and retained evidence](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/1fd973b318313dc1f1e524f7a1e71f245380d29b/docs/review/pr6-catalog-cancel/README.md). The broader **65-scenario Chromium suite** passed on original source `4cdeb323fb8ebfa5247193e47cf73d56f025e007`; unchanged landing-page and unrelated checks are reused with that scope. Current-revision CI is recorded in [Checks](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6/checks). Engineering review, independent QA verdicts and coordinator receipts are recorded separately in the [PR conversation](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6#discussion_bucket). These are browser captures, not physical-device evidence. Live AI matching/generation accuracy and latency were not re-evaluated; synthetic replies and a real retained library PNG establish the shown behavior. Android/iPad checks remain outstanding. Unsaved conversation drafts remain in memory. The exact API-rendered PR body and embedded image pixels were inspected; full authenticated GitHub-page layout remains unverified because the browser UI tool failed to initialize. No baseline waiver or readiness is implied. Original iteration evidence is retained in the [cleanup record](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6#issuecomment-6000259404), outside the main base-to-final comparison.

issue.title: Add automatic card pictures and a live board workspace
issue.body:
Backfill for existing PR #6 only; no new implementation or ownership assignment.

Parents need clearer pictures when emoji are ambiguous and room to refine a board while viewing it. Preserve the published automatic emoji/library/generated-picture selection and full-page draft workspace, explicit save/cancel behavior, protected photos, offline saved PNGs, source controls and picture-data disclosure. Existing web introduction and /app entry remain within PR6's published scope.

Acceptance: verify representative genuine Before/After evidence and source/build/fixture provenance; picture fallback, stopped work, save/retry, protected photos and offline persistence remain correct. Complete the outstanding authenticated rendered-PR inspection without claiming physical-device/live-provider tests ran.

Current PR: https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6 (2be85f0cb02cd5ba464f46c623b9b19cf5061231). Existing owner: 01a10d30-f0f8-7529-8e14-cb54d10fb018, idle per published checkpoint; retain ownership. Stage: Blocked, based on independent QA https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6#issuecomment-6002210899. No readiness or merge implied. Foundation PR15 depends on this work; keep TestFlight issue #12 separate.
